title: Dr. Patel follow-up visit
notes: Synthetic script for actors. Contains: one dated instruction (bloodwork before Dec 14), one scheduled appointment (Dec 21), one medication instruction that is explicitly unchanged, one question the doctor defers (dizziness referral), and one patient worry with no answer (driving). No real patient data.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Good to see you again, Mary. How have you been feeling since we adjusted the blood pressure medication?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Mostly fine. A little dizzy some mornings when I get out of bed, but it passes.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Okay. Your pressure today is 128 over 80, which is much better. I don't want to change the lisinopril. Keep taking ten milligrams every morning, same as now.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: About the dizziness, when you get up, sit on the edge of the bed for a minute first. If it keeps happening, I may send you to a cardiologist, but let's look at your labs before we decide that.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Yes. I'd like a basic metabolic panel and a lipid panel. It's a fasting test, so nothing to eat after midnight. Please get it done before December fourteenth so the results are back before I see you.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: You can go to any Quest lab. The order will be in the system by tomorrow.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: And when do I come back to see you?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: The front desk has you down for December twenty-first at ten thirty. We'll go over the lab results then and decide about the cardiology referral.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: My daughter wanted me to ask whether the dizziness means I shouldn't be driving.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: That's a fair question. If you ever feel dizzy while sitting, don't drive that day. Otherwise let's talk about it properly once we have the labs.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Okay. Nothing to eat after midnight, before the fourteenth.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Exactly. And drink plenty of water that morning, it makes the draw easier. Any other questions?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: No, I think that's it. Thank you.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Take care, Mary. See you on the twenty-first.
